title: Lift at a negative leading sign
statement: Let $n$ be a natural number, let $f$ be a function from $\\{-1,1\\}^n$ to the signs $\\{\\pm1\\}$, and let $x\\in\\{-1,1\\}^n$. The balanced lift of $f$, evaluated at the vector with first coordinate $-1$ and remaining coordinates $x$, equals $-f(-x)$.
